method: one independent input at a time; production kernel only
thickness_representation: half of production measured_physical (total paired intrinsic thickness), versus physical baseline camber polyline arclength at matching xi; not an actual surface

fixed_gui_inputs.cascade.blade_count: Held at the reference count by user request; no blade-count sweep.

coverage.not_geometry_inputs: preview visibility/colors/copy count and passage-crosscut display toggle are display preferences; YAML/reset actions are state operations

sweeps.meaning: Select a cylinder or a radial plane; Meanline sets this read-only field in the editor.
sweeps.effect: Changes the physical mapping. The radial outline is in the machine X-Y plane; the axial outline is developed from its cylinder.
sweeps.coupling: Only type changes: radial radii remain 20 and 35 mm, while the axial chord is retained as an inactive input. This is a mapping comparison, not an equal-size blade comparison.
sweeps.range_rationale: Both supported surfaces, with all other independent inputs fixed.

sweeps.meaning: Radius midway between axial hub and shroud.
sweeps.effect: The developed 2D profile is unchanged. Pitch grows with radius and the channel moves radially.
sweeps.coupling: The hub must remain positive. A cylinder is an isometry when developed; a chart-coordinate change is not a physical outline change.
sweeps.range_rationale: 90%, 95%, 100% and 110% of the reference radius; count remains fixed.

sweeps.meaning: Span between hub and shroud, or separation of radial endwalls.
sweeps.effect: Changes span; the supported untwisted section has the same developed 2D shape.
sweeps.coupling: Independent of chord and count. Axial hub radius must stay positive; this model does not add spanwise twist.
sweeps.range_rationale: 90%, 95%, 100% and 110% of the 10 mm reference span.

sweeps.meaning: Axial separation of camberline endpoints.
sweeps.effect: Scales both camber and nominal thickness in physical units; rounded edges can protrude beyond the endpoints.
sweeps.coupling: All thickness ratios remain fixed, so dimensional thickness changes naturally. Pitch stays fixed and large chords can collide with neighbors. Inactive for radial geometry.
sweeps.range_rationale: 90%, 95%, 100% and 110% of the reference chord, at fixed count and radius.

sweeps.meaning: Radius at the radial camberline inlet.
sweeps.effect: Changes radial chord, conformal scale and mapped curvature and thickness.
sweeps.coupling: Outlet radius stays 35 mm; equal inlet/outlet radii are rejected. This field is hidden for an axial cylinder.
sweeps.range_rationale: 18, 19, 20 and 22 mm: a local comparison around 20 mm, away from equal radii.

sweeps.meaning: Radius at the radial camberline outlet.
sweeps.effect: Changes radial extent and the radius-dependent physical thickness.
sweeps.coupling: Inlet radius stays 20 mm. The inactive axial chord is not adjusted; equal radii are rejected.
sweeps.range_rationale: 31.5, 33.25, 35 and 38.5 mm: a local comparison around 35 mm.

sweeps.meaning: Signed inlet tangent angle measured from downstream meridional direction.
sweeps.effect: Rotates the inlet tangent and changes turning, arclength and circumferential displacement.
sweeps.coupling: Outlet angle and all shape inputs stay fixed. Neither preset nor pressure-side selection is manually changed when an angle changes.
sweeps.range_rationale: Baseline minus 5 and 2.5 degrees, the baseline, and baseline plus 5 degrees.

sweeps.meaning: Signed outlet tangent angle measured from downstream meridional direction.
sweeps.effect: Moves the trailing endpoint circumferentially and changes total turning and blade length.
sweeps.coupling: The nominal thickness law is unchanged, but its physical orientation and curvature change. No aerodynamic deviation is predicted.
sweeps.range_rationale: Baseline minus 5 and 2.5 degrees, the baseline, and baseline plus 5 degrees.

sweeps.meaning: Blend metal angles directly, or blend their tangents before converting to angles.
sweeps.effect: Changes the interior camberline while retaining both endpoint angles.
sweeps.coupling: Half-turning location means half the angle change in angle mode and half the tangent change in slope mode.
sweeps.range_rationale: Both current GUI choices are included.

sweeps.meaning: Conformal meridional station at half the selected turning interpolation.
sweeps.effect: Moves turning forward or aft and changes the circumferential endpoint position.
sweeps.coupling: This is neither camber arclength fraction nor necessarily the maximum-curvature station. Concentration remains fixed.
sweeps.range_rationale: Baseline offsets -0.05, -0.025, 0 and +0.05 keep the turning station close to its preset.

sweeps.meaning: Concentrate the tangent change around the turning location.
sweeps.effect: Higher values create straighter end regions and sharper turning in between.
sweeps.coupling: High curvature can fold a thick normal offset. Intersections are rejected rather than repaired by reducing thickness.
sweeps.range_rationale: 90%, 95%, 100% and 110% of the preset concentration, all above the minimum of one.

sweeps.meaning: Nominal full body thickness divided by conformal meridional chord.
sweeps.effect: Adds or removes central body thickness without moving the camberline.
sweeps.coupling: The final physical maximum and its station can differ after rounding, relief and radial mapping. Ratios are full thickness, not half-thickness.
sweeps.range_rationale: 90%, 95%, 100% and 110% of the reference body ratio show modest thinning and thickening.

sweeps.meaning: Conformal meridional station of the nominal body thickness value.
sweeps.effect: Moves the thick region forward or aft while holding endpoint body values fixed.
sweeps.coupling: The actual maximum need not occur here, especially with unequal endpoint body thickness. It is not arclength fraction.
sweeps.range_rationale: Baseline offsets -0.05, -0.025, 0 and +0.05 show a local displacement of the thick region.

sweeps.meaning: Full unrounded body thickness at the leading endpoint, divided by conformal chord.
sweeps.effect: Changes the nose and the linear contribution to the body thickness.
sweeps.coupling: This is not tip radius. With rounding enabled the final tip closes; the rounding fraction and exponent remain fixed.
sweeps.range_rationale: 90%, 95%, 100% and 110% of the unrounded reference value; no degenerate zero-body tip.

sweeps.meaning: Full unrounded body thickness at the trailing endpoint, divided by conformal chord.
sweeps.effect: Changes the trailing shoulder and the body baseline.
sweeps.coupling: A rounded trailing tip still closes to zero width; this is not a finite blunt trailing-edge thickness or an edge-radius prescription.
sweeps.range_rationale: 90%, 95%, 100% and 110% of the unrounded reference trailing value.

sweeps.meaning: Conformal chord fraction over which the leading tip closes into the body.
sweeps.effect: Larger fractions spread rounding downstream. Zero leaves an unrounded endpoint joined by a straight cap.
sweeps.coupling: The leading relief window also depends on this fraction. That dependent change is allowed; relief strength is held fixed. Fraction is not radius.
sweeps.range_rationale: 80%, 90%, 100% and 120% of the reference fraction retain the small preset rounding extent.

sweeps.meaning: Conformal chord fraction measured backward from the trailing tip.
sweeps.effect: Controls the extent of trailing closure; zero produces a straight closing cap.
sweeps.coupling: Rounding factors can overlap if their fractions sum above one. The current GUI has no trailing-edge relief control.
sweeps.range_rationale: 80%, 90%, 100% and 120% of the reference trailing rounding fraction.

sweeps.meaning: Independent rational modification of the leading reference shoulder.
sweeps.effect: Negative values narrow and positive values fill the shoulder; zero at both ends recovers the Denton body.
sweeps.coupling: The modification has global support. The trailing fullness is fixed, and some opposed pairs fail the joint rational-denominator check.
sweeps.range_rationale: Baseline offsets -0.1, -0.05, 0 and +0.1 explore local shoulder changes inside the individual bounds.

sweeps.meaning: Independent rational modification of the trailing reference shoulder.
sweeps.effect: Changes the trailing shoulder, with some influence elsewhere along the body.
sweeps.coupling: Leading fullness is never linked to this sweep. Symmetry generally breaks in the impulse example when only one shoulder changes.
sweeps.range_rationale: Baseline offsets -0.1, -0.05, 0 and +0.1; the opposite shoulder is fixed.

sweeps.meaning: Broadness of the central Denton body contribution.
sweeps.effect: Larger exponents broaden the central thick region in its transformed coordinate.
sweeps.coupling: At 1 the peak can have a corner; between 1 and 2 curvature can be singular. Warnings do not imply an intersection rejection.
sweeps.range_rationale: 1.8, 1.9, 2 and 2.2 bracket the preset without reaching the corner limit at one.

warnings: Body shape exponent below 2: the nominal body peak can have a corner (1) or singular curvature (between 1 and 2).
Body shape exponent below 2: the nominal body peak can have a corner (1) or singular curvature (between 1 and 2).
A noninteger Denton exponent can limit higher-derivative smoothness at the body peak.

sweeps.meaning: Rate at which leading rounding recovers unrounded body thickness.
sweeps.effect: Higher values recover thickness faster inside the same rounding interval.
sweeps.coupling: Separate from the body exponent. A value of 2 can produce a curvature jump at the rounding shoulder; tip radius also changes.
sweeps.range_rationale: 2.7, 2.85, 3 and 3.3 compare small changes around the preset three.

sweeps.meaning: Rate at which the trailing tip approaches the unrounded body.
sweeps.effect: Changes the local trailing closure without changing the camberline.
sweeps.coupling: Neither exponent nor rounding fraction directly prescribes a circular cap or wedge angle.
sweeps.range_rationale: 2.7, 2.85, 3 and 3.3 match the local leading exponent comparison.

sweeps.meaning: Remove thickness near the leading edge from the automatically inferred pressure side.
sweeps.effect: Changes one actual surface and reduces the plotted half of total paired thickness; the camberline remains unchanged.
sweeps.coupling: Turning direction selects the side. Relief is inactive at zero rounding extent and cannot automatically choose a side for nonzero relief on a zero-turning blade.
sweeps.range_rationale: Reaction: 0.125, 0.1375, 0.15 and 0.175. Impulse: 0, 0.0125, 0.025 and 0.05, since its baseline lies at the lower bound.

sweeps.meaning: Rescale chart offsets to approximately retain the intended physical paired thickness as radius changes.
sweeps.effect: Changes radial outlines and thickness; on an axial cylinder the factor is identically one.
sweeps.coupling: The correction is first order in thickness/radius. Residual error can remain after nonlinear mapping; it does not enforce a minimum distance between complete surfaces.
sweeps.range_rationale: Both Boolean choices on the documented radial example.

sweeps.meaning: Relative mapped-thickness discrepancy at which correction issues a warning.
sweeps.effect: Changes diagnostics only, not geometry. Thresholds and physical-thickness errors are recorded in the manifest.
sweeps.coupling: Only active with physical correction enabled. This sweep uses a separate, explicitly corrected radial baseline; the axial cylinder has effectively zero error.
sweeps.range_rationale: 0.75%, 0.9%, 1% and 1.25% compare thresholds close to the preset one percent.

sweeps.meaning: Upstream extension requested from the production downstream passage adapter.
sweeps.effect: Changes the flow-domain boundary while the blade and camberline remain fixed.
sweeps.coupling: Extensions use the downstream adapter's reference chord and automatic passage placement; no replacement rectangular domain is constructed here.
sweeps.range_rationale: 80%, 90%, 100% and 120% of the preset upstream extension.

sweeps.meaning: Downstream extension requested from the production passage adapter.
sweeps.effect: Moves downstream domain boundaries without changing the blade outline.
sweeps.coupling: The inlet extension stays fixed. Automatic passage placement can move other domain boundaries as a dependent result.
sweeps.range_rationale: 80%, 90%, 100% and 120% of the preset downstream extension.

sweeps.meaning: Base stations for geometry sampling and sampled validation.
sweeps.effect: Changes discretization, not the analytic shape law. The manifest records convergence against a 2401-base-point reference.
sweeps.coupling: Additional edge/shoulder stations make actual sample count larger. Low resolution can miss crossings and distort curvature; it is not a shape-control substitute.
sweeps.range_rationale: 501, 551, 601 and 701 base points compare nearby resolutions around the preset 601.
